lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce2Zn2Sn2 (CeZnSn) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 14 geometric neighbors (2 Ce, 6 Sn, 6 Zn), Sn centers with 10 neighbors (2 Ce, 2 Sn, 6 Zn), and Zn centers with 12 neighbors (2 Ce, 4 Sn, 6 Zn), all described as coordination polyhedra. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Ce and Zn polyhedra, corner- and edge-sharing between Sn and Zn polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Ce polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all six sites.
